study: B-09 Phase 3b — Ruling A (PIT-UNRESOLVED) + Ruling B (B/M Metric Closure)

ruling_A_pit_unresolved.rule: For stocks whose current TSE class disagrees with the last dated record, the interval from that record onward is UNRESOLVED: no current-snapshot backfill, no persistence assumption. Industry = NA -> Value = NA -> dropped by B-15 complete-case.
ruling_A_pit_unresolved.note: Quantified only. Per ruling, this number must NOT be used to change the rule.

lineage_1_over_PBR_vs_BE_over_ME.identity_tested: ME = PER x Earnings and ME = PBR x BookEquity  =>  PBR/PER = Earnings/BookEquity = ROE_ttm. A ratio of (PBR/PER)/ROE_ttm ~= 1 confirms PER_TSE and PBR_TSE share one market-cap and one share basis, i.e. 1/PBR_TSE is BE/ME.
